title: Checking a workout code ignores the gym's own offer: app check-ins count, and it offers 3 days whatever the reward
what: When the desk checks a member's workout code, every check-in counts, including app and QR poster check-ins, even when the owner set the offer to 'Only desk check-ins count'. The check never says how many workouts the offer needs, and Give extra days always starts at 3 days, even when the offer's reward is 1, 5 or 7 days.
expected: The check follows the running offer: it counts only the check-ins the offer counts, shows 'N of the M workouts needed', and Give extra days starts at the offer's own reward days.
who: owners and desk staff running a workout offer
fix_line: Pass the running offer into the code check and use its check-in rule, target and reward days.

title: The member card's WhatsApp message is always in English, even when the gym chose Hindi for member messages
what: The gym picks English, Hindi or Both for messages to members, and the ready messages and the member page's WhatsApp words follow it. The member card's Send on WhatsApp message does not read that choice and is always English.
expected: The member card message follows the gym's message language like every other member message.
who: members of gyms that message in Hindi
fix_line: Give the card message a Hindi and Both version and pick it from the gym message language.

title: The gym's message language is kept only on one device, so the desk's phone still sends English
what: The language of messages to members is described as one choice for the whole gym, but it is saved only in the browser where it was picked. The owner picks Hindi on the laptop; the desk's phone, a second staff login or a new browser still starts every member message in English.
expected: A gym-wide message language is saved with the gym, so every device and staff login uses it.
who: gyms with more than one device or staff login
fix_line: Save the message language with the gym's settings on the server; keep the browser copy only as a fallback.

title: Today's Approve and Yes/No buttons are not greyed out with no internet
what: With no internet, buttons that need the server are greyed out with 'Needs internet'. The pause and renew requests card and the numbers-to-confirm card on Today do not do this: the desk can tap Approve or Yes, and only then gets a failure line. A pause approved this way moves the plan on this device while the request stays open.
expected: These buttons are greyed out with 'Needs internet' while offline, like the other server-only buttons.
who: front desk on a weak connection
how_often: whenever offline with a request waiting
fix_line: Mark these buttons as needing internet.
